query:
INSERT INTO black_market (
                market_id,
                name,
                sell_price,
                prohibited,
                listed_at)
            VALUES ($1, LOWER($2), $3, $4, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (market_id, name)
            DO UPDATE SET
                sell_price = $3,
                prohibited = $4,
                listed_at = $5
            WHERE black_market.listed_at <= $5
